name: Thomas Baird
office: East Whittier City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 4

items.text: Thomas Baird was appointed to the East Whittier City School District Board of Education for Trustee Area 4 in 2026. He is a licensed clinical social worker who holds a master's degree in social work from Rutgers University and a master's degree from Princeton Theological Seminary.
